summary: Burst credit missing from invoice after legacy postback aggregator merged mixed-queue hourly lines
description:
Issue summary: Customer BrightPlan AI reports that a burst credit they purchased to cover a short, high-throughput window (2026-03-10 09:00-09:15 UTC) does not appear on the finalized invoice for 2026-03-10. Impact: customer sees an unexpected ~USD 4,200 charge vs expected USD 0 for that window. Environment: dedicated pool (org ID: bp-88) in us-east, mixed-queue ingest (sync chat + batch embeddings).

Observed behaviour: multiple hourly postbacks from the mixed queue were compressed by the legacy postback-aggregator into a single invoice line; during compression the burst_credit_applied flag was dropped and volume was attributed to reserved usage bucket. Expected behaviour: aggregator should preserve per-postback credit tags and ensure burst credits are applied before reserved rate reconciliation.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Run short high-concurrency workload that triggers burst credits (simulate 2k concurrent tokens for 15 minutes) on dedicated pool. 2) Ensure mixed-queue routing (chat and embed requests interleaved). 3) Let hourly postback worker emit multiple postbacks for same org within an hour. 4) Run postback-aggregator in legacy compression mode (--compress-hourly=true). 5) Observe final invoice line credit attribution.

Relevant logs (redacted):
- postback-aggregator.log @ 2026-03-10T09:15:02Z: "merge_candidate count=7 org=bp-88 window=2026-03-10T09:00:00Z key=hourly_truncate"
- reconciler.log @ 2026-03-10T09:18:11Z: "applied_rate=reserved, credits_consumed=0, burst_credit_marker=null org=bp-88"
- chargecalc.debug @ 2026-03-10T09:18:12Z: "input_lines=7 compressed_line_id=hc-20260310-09-bp88 orig_credits=[burst:1] compressed_credits=[]"

Customer impact: Customer revenue team froze autopay and requested immediate invoice correction and provisional refund. Billing team flagged as potential SLA breach for Dedicated customers.

investigation_notes:
Timeline: investigated postback-aggregator compression logic after customer dispute. Root cause: legacy aggregator groups postbacks by truncated hour and merges entries using last-write-wins for metadata fields. In mixed-queue scenarios the last postback often belongs to reserved routing (long-lived sessions), overwriting earlier burst_credit markers. Reproducer: replayed pb-9001..pb-9007 in staging with compress=true and confirmed credits_consumed reduced to 0. Impact surface: likely affects dedicated customers with mixed-queue bursts where compression is enabled. Likelihood: medium (aggregator v2.1.0 used on a subset of dedicated pools). Potential breakage: incorrect invoices (overcharge) and missing credit history entries in ledger.

Logs/observations: chargecalc.debug shows compressed_credits=[] even though orig_credits included burst:1 for pb-9003 and pb-9005. Patch idea: change merge to union credit sets and preserve credit precedence (burst > reserved). Also add unit test covering mixed-queue merge.

Action items: 1) Apply hotfix to postback-aggregator to preserve credit metadata (PR #452). 2) Backfill affected invoices for bp-88 via manual adjustment and issue provisional refund. 3) Run reconciliation for last 72 hours to find other affected orgs. 4) Disable legacy compress flag for dedicated pools until hotfix deployed. 5) Add e2e test in billing pipeline.
resolution: Workaround: disabled --legacy-compress on us-east dedicated pools at 2026-03-13T18:00Z which prevented further mis-aggregation. Hotfix (billing PR #452) merged to main on 2026-03-14 02:15Z and rolled to staging. We performed a targeted backfill: created invoice credit memo CM-20260314-BP88 for USD 4,200 and applied provisional refund to BrightPlan's outstanding balance; customer notified by Support. Post-deployment reconciliation script ran 2026-03-14 06:20Z and found 3 additional orgs with similar compression artifacts; those invoices are queued for adjustment and ops notified. Follow-ups: 1) Billing ENG to run full 7-day audit and prepare postmortem (owner: Diego Ramos). 2) Add aggregator union-metadata test and include burst-credit precedence rule. 3) Update dedicated deployment runbook to disable legacy compress by default. Status: Mitigated (provisional credit issued); root cause fix merged and hotfix rollout in progress; invoices for affected orgs under remediation.
